# Exaptation Studio

Exaptation Studio is the venture studio of LGI Sustainable Innovation. It builds and tests ventures by repurposing European R&D, sustainability expertise and existing technologies.

Official website: https://exaptation.studio/
Contact: thomas@exaptation.studio
Parent organisation: LGI Sustainable Innovation — https://lgi.earth/

## Green Claims Fix

Official page: https://exaptation.studio/green-claims-fix/

Green Claims Fix helps brands identify environmental marketing claims, understand which claims need attention, map the evidence needed to substantiate them, identify evidence gaps, and prepare clearer evidence-aligned wording and a structured substantiation file.

Primary market: France and the European Union.
Typical users: consumer brands, ecommerce companies, marketing teams, sustainability teams and product teams using environmental claims on websites, product pages, packaging, advertising or marketplaces.

Green Claims Fix supports compliance preparation and evidence readiness. It is not legal advice, certification or assurance.

Key concepts: green claims, environmental claims, greenwashing risk, environmental marketing compliance, substantiation, evidence readiness, Directive (EU) 2024/825, EmpCo, France, EU.
